summary: Created a compact reference-only safety specification for a future Telegram/mobile operator layer. The spec limits mobile use to summaries, pointers, provisional intent capture, and escalation-safe flows while forbidding execution, runtime mutation, credential exposure, Telegram enablement, and any second-source-of-truth behavior.
recommended_next_action: Use this spec as the safety baseline for any future Telegram/mobile design review, and require a separate explicitly approved implementation task before enabling any bot, parser, or writeback behavior.
